TABLE.NAME: local_metatags_tags
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores meta tag configuration by page type

FIELD.NAME: pagetype
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle page type. E.g. course-view-*, blog-*, site-index. Use custom for URL-specific configuration and * for global configuration.

FIELD.NAME: urlpath
FIELD.COMMENT: URL path for custom page type. Empty for non-custom page types.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this configuration is enabled. 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when the record was created.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when the record was last modified.
